Name: NPC Rock
Author: boxosoup
Description:
The rock changes location depending on each day of the week. You can gift the rock. 

Gift tastes: default
Birthday: Spring 22

How to roommate with rock: Go to Pierre's seed shop and buy the "rock roommate item" and give it to rock once your friendship is high enough.

Any suggestions are welcome. Translations are okay too, but don't send me anything that uses google translate or deepl/ai.

You only need to translate:
[code]﻿ {
"rock": "...",
"rock.name": "Rock",
"rockitem": "Rock Roommate Item",
"rockitemdesc": "Use this item on the rock to make it a housemate."
}
[/code]
